@graph.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani) at Home
@graph.description: Butter chicken (murgh makhani) at home: charred yoghurt-marinated chicken in a silky tomato, butter and cream sauce, and the court case over who invented it.
recipeIngredient: 700 g boneless chicken thighs, in chunks
1 tsp salt, juice of ½ lemon
1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala
Salt to taste; coriander to garnish

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate. Mix the marinade ingredients with the chicken and rest it for at least 1 hour, or overnight in the fridge.
Char. Grill, air-fry or sear the chicken in a very hot pan until charred at the edges and just cooked. Set aside.
Build the sauce. Melt the butter with the oil, soften the onion for 6–8 min, then add the ginger-garlic paste for 1 min.
Simmer. Add the tomato purée, chilli and garam masala. Cook for 10–12 min until it thickens and the butter separates at the edges. Blend smooth if you like.
Finish. Stir in the chicken, the crushed kasuri methi, sugar and cream. Simmer for 5 min and season.
Serve with naan or jeera rice, a knob of butter and some coriander.
